Subject: Re: POC — brief note from today's demo

Hi all — I reviewed the logs Sara attached plus our request traces for the same timeslot. Summary of findings:

- Timeline: 2027-04-07T16:20:00Z — 2027-04-07T16:26:00Z: a short degradation window with elevated tail latency and ~3% 504s for requests routed to a GPU cluster node that experienced an autoscaler lag during a burst.
- Root cause: autoscaler scaling policy did not spin up a replacement instance quickly enough for the burst of concurrent streaming sessions. We have a bug ticket (INC-2247) open to adjust the cooldown and reactive scaling thresholds.
- Impact: estimate ~12k tokens worth of served workload that either timed out or returned errors during the window for Brightline's POC.

Remediation proposal (pre-approved playbook for demo-impact incidents):
1) Token top-up: 15,000 tokens to be added to Brightline's account immediately (covers the failed requests + buffer).
2) POC window extension: 14 calendar days added to the existing POC end-date.
3) Post-mortem & mitigation: write-up + timeline to be shared within 72 hours; we’ll include a mitigation ETA for scaler tuning.

Attachments: brief incident_log_20270407.txt

Sara/Chris — please let us know whether that package looks acceptable and, if yes, confirm the best email to send the credit memo to for your finance/procurement team.

Naomi — Marissa, can you pre-authorize the token top-up so we can issue it once Brightline confirms? I’m marking this as an incident-caused remediation — no sales credit needed.

Thanks,
Rishi Malhotra
SRE Lead, Redwood Inference
